# Mini Season: Love Hurts (February 2026)

![Mini Season: Love Hurts (February 2026)](/uploads/636_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

A new mini season is just around the corner. This time it was already announced in the community calendar. The Mini Season's motto is "Love hurts" and of course the period is placed around Valentine's Day.

### Mini season period

**02/03/2026 (6 p.m.) - 02/17/2026 (6 p.m.)**

This mini season will also have a new area next to the season. If you press "Season" in the main menu, a selection will open in which you can choose the current season 23 or the mini season. In both you can collect the rewards with the same tickets.

As with the other mini seasons, the rewards must be redeemed one at a time. First the helmet and then one after the other. Each reward states which other reward must be redeemed beforehand.

Tickets are earned as usual through the daily and weekly challenges.

## Free Challenge Item

### Tough-but-kind-helmet

Bring fear and flaming pink passion across the wasteland with the Tough But Kind Helmet!

- THIS CLOTHING CAN BE CRAFTED AT ARMOR WORKBENCHES. -

*Note:* This time it is again possible to complete the challenges in power armor. There is a new function in the challenges called "WornInOrOutOfPowerArmor", which detects if you wear a costume before entering the PA and counts it towards the challenges.

## Mini Season Rewards

### Destroyed Heart Bow

Raiders express their love a little differently and now you can too: with the Destroyed Heart Bow!

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS WILL BE DISPLAYED IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

### Killer cozy sofa

Buff: Rush of Love (1 hr) +25% Chem Duration

Love is the most powerful drug of all. Let yourself sink in really nicely.
